# اِرْتَضَيْتِ (irtaḍayti) /ir.ta.dˤaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِرْتَضَى (irtaḍā)
# اُرْتُضِيتُ (urtuḍītu) /ur.tu.dˤiː.tu/: first-person singu
